text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "Special Jury Award", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "In Switzerland, more and more electricity is being produced locally and fed into the electricity distribution network, for example from photovoltaic systems on buildings, while ever more consumers are drawing electricity from the distribution network, such as for electric vehicles and heat pumps.", "severity": 0.4, "before": "In Switzerland,"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Par ailleurs, le nombre de consommateurs (voitures électriques, pompes à chaleurs, etc.) soutirant de l’électricité depuis le réseau de distribution est lui aussi en hausse.", "severity": 0.4, "before": "Par ailleurs,"}]}
